summary: Senior front-end engineer with 10+ years building React and TypeScript applications and 6+ years shipping production interactive visualizations with D3.js and SVG for Walmart Global Tech, IBM/AEP, HCSC, and IoT and delivery startups. Integrates visualizations into design systems and dashboards with Redux / Zustand / React Query state, tests them with Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress, and ships through GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps CI/CD. Node.js / Express and Java / Spring Boot API work on the back end; GitHub Copilot and Claude Code in daily use.
